Subject: Trip.com - UAE Partnership Team Update
Hi Everyone, 
I hope you’re all doing well. 
I wanted to share a couple of updates to our team structure that will help us continue strengthening our partnership with you. 
I’m pleased to announce that Anuj will be stepping into the role of Director – Middle East & Africa. Based in Dubai, Anuj will continue reporting to me and will work closely with all of you from a strategic partnership perspective, helping us further deepen our collaboration and identify new growth opportunities across the region. 
At the same time, I’m delighted to introduce Snehal, who will be taking on the additional responsibility of Airline Partnership Manager for the UAE, alongside her existing responsibilities for Africa. Snehal will be your primary point of contact for day-to-day account management, commercial initiatives, and performance discussions in the UAE market, while becoming part of Anuj’s wider team. These changes are part of our continued investment in the region, ensuring we provide even stronger strategic support while remaining closely aligned with your business objectives. 
Please join me in congratulating Anuj and Snehal on their new responsibilities. I’m confident they’ll be great partners, and I know they’ll appreciate your continued support as they transition into their expanded roles. While Anuj and Snehal will be leading these areas, I’ll remain closely involved and, as always, I’m only a message or call away should you ever need my support. 
Thank you for your continued partnership, and I look forward to achieving even greater success together. Best regards,
With Regards, 
Shrey Nayar
Head of Flight Marketing Solutions
Director Flight Business - Middle East, Africa & Indian Subcontinent

Dear Khun Rajiv,
Before we break for the Eid festivities, I wanted to drop a quick note thanking you for your participation in the airline conference earlier this month. With Amsterdam cruising at its finest, our dialogue was exactly the kind that moves things forward — and I am confident of us fostering a strategic and long-term partnership with Air Arabia in the coming days, to deliver exceptional business growth. 
With this note, I want to run a quick recap on the foundations that are rooted in a commercially rewarding partnership and engaging more closely on marketing initiatives while striving to serve our customers better. 
Towards a partnership for all seasons 
Currently, Air Arabia and Trip.com have tactical and ad-hoc commercial engagement, which limits us from making the most of your expansive network and our market reach. With Europe-Asia being the corridor of strategic importance for both, we look forward to having a more structured approach to these routes so that we can jointly win more of the market. 
Collaboration across marketing and KOL engagement 
Our marketing experiments through KOL have yielded exceptional results in the Asian markets, and as we take this engagement to Europe, I am keen to leverage this pillar of growth with Air Arabia to support the Europe-Asia corridor further. We can jointly evaluate micro-influencer content and seeded user content opportunities to promote the G9 experience. 
Extending the scope of TO fares 
TO fares have contributed promisingly to the growth of Trip's business with G9 in the past. However, their contribution to the overall sale has been declining with a curtailment in both the routes and discounts for TO fares. It will be in our mutual best interest to revisit the TO fares strategy and close on a bi-annual calendar, catering to leans and peaks, with focus on Asia departure markets.
VCC surcharge and cost optimization 
As we discuss and navigate through an aggressive growth plan, the card surcharge remains to be a key blocker in the journey. I completely understand the cost-of-sale rationale for an airline and assure you that we are happy to work with you on optimizing the same with more granularity and precision. I suggest that we revisit the card types in usage and waive the surcharge for the ones that do not make a dent in the form of MDR charges to you, thus, keeping the costs in check while ensuring aggressive business growth. 
I apologize for this long read; our opportunities together are just endless! It would be great to have your feedback on the above and add action items that I may have missed. Let us plan for an in-person meeting post the Eid break to take the discussion forward towards a stronger future. 
Eid-al-Adha Mubarak to you and your loved ones. 
Best regards,
Anuj Bansal
Senior Manager – United Arab Emirates
